Name: Zebah, King of Midian
Summary: Zebah, a king of Midian, fled from Gideon, was captured at Karkor, and was killed by Gideon after Succoth and Penuel refused bread to his army.
KeyStory: Gideon pursued Zebah and Zalmunna beyond Jordan, captured them at Karkor, and killed them himself when his firstborn Jether feared to draw his sword.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zalmunna, King of Midian; Oreb, Prince of Midian; Zeeb, Prince of Midian
LifeLesson: Kings who mocked a small army were judged by the man they mocked.
